clan.name: Knights Renegade
clan.description: 🏰 Knights Renegade 🏰We are a brotherhood (and sisterhood!) of seasoned warriors, strategists, and jesters who know how to fight fiercely and laugh loudly. Our guild, Level 100, is well-established, offering all the powerful benefits that come with it.Forged from the union of The Renegades and Jesters Reborn, we’ve become more than a guild, we are a family. We support one another through fair trades, active swap threads, and by helping newer players build their Great Buildings and sharpen their strategies.Our banners fly high in Guild Expeditions, where we’ve long held dominance — and now, we charge boldly into the fierce fields of GBG and the chaos of QI.⸻🛡️ Code of the Order 🛡️Only Knights and Dames of eighteen winters or more may join our order.Why? Because our quests are noble, our banter bold, and our tavern talk too perilous for pages still scrubbing their parents’ chalices.⸻⚔️ Duties of the Knights ⚔️✨ New Minimums:1000 Progress in QI (Questline Incursion)600 in GBG (Guild Battlegrounds)GE is now optional Discord - we encourage all players to join, once you have… then you will see why !!⸻🏇 If you seek to rise with honour, grow in strength, and laugh in the face of battle ….join us.We fight with courage, lead with wisdom, and lift each other higher every day.⸻🧭 Council of Founders:	Knight-Commander Jayamos, Flame of the EastKnight-Commander SKing, Shield of the SouthKnight-Commander DiZZi, Blade of the WestKnight-Commander Foxy, Arrow of the NorthFour blades, one oath.⸻🏹 Honoured Champions of the OrderTTEqualsHelmet, Warden of the HighlandsA fierce ally, trusted leader, and stalwart presence in every battle.📜 Guild Creed“Fortes ludere, sapientes vincere.”“The brave play, the wise win.”“Fratres in bello, comites in risu.”“Brothers in war, companions in laughter.”
